result.topic_en: Numerical evaluation of the integral of x dx over the cube root of (1 − x^3), with series partial sums giving a value of about 0.684 at x = 1, and side calculations ending in the expression π/(3√(3/4)).

methods.what: Numerical value of the definite integral from 0 to 1 of x/(1−x^3)^{1/3}, obtained by summing series terms
Series partial sums (two columns of decreasing terms) used to compute the integral
Addition of partial results to obtain the total value
Functional relation for an auxiliary function M
Trial solution M(x) = A/x^2 and the resulting condition
Closed-form expression involving π, written next to the numerical results
